title: welcome
description: Resident to client, the answer to hello: the version, the resident's name and process, and the limits it applies.

max_frame_bytes.description: Longest line a client may send, newline excluded.

max_reply_bytes.description: Longest line the resident sends; a larger result is a reply_too_large error.

max_connections.description: Connections the resident holds at once.

max_in_flight.description: Requests one connection may have running at once.

max_queued_events.description: Events that may wait unread for one subscriber before it is disconnected.

max_queued_event_bytes.description: Bytes of events that may wait unread for one subscriber.

handshake_timeout_ms.description: How long a connection may take to say hello.
